decision: Run the herdr-claude bootstrap as a new agent container's own zsh -c command instead of typing it into its running shell (port of PR #485, second half)
rationale: buildFullCommand('herdr-claude') is a ~1000-character pipeline; scheduleCommand() wrote it into the pty and the shell echoed all of it. runsAsContainerCommand(mode, containerName, command) is the one predicate both server/backends/container.ts and the connection handler use, limited to docker run of a new container, so docker exec and local shells keep the typed path and nothing runs twice. Smoke-tested 2026-11-15 on the pinned -gsd image under a pty: zero occurrences of the bootstrap text on screen
alternatives: #485's connection-handler gate on the command alone (rejected: it also skipped typing for docker exec and mode=local, where the container command is not the bootstrap, so the command would never run); stty -echo around the write (rejected: races the echo)

decision: Drop #485's resolveHerdrImage redirect to the Full Bundle
rationale: Probed 2026-11-15: every digest-pinned agent image on main (daax-agents bd80594f, daax-agents-gsd 2a631fe0, and -core, -flowspec, -openspec) has /usr/local/bin/herdr. The 'Herdr is not installed' failure it fixed no longer occurs on any published variant
alternatives: Port it anyway (rejected: it would override an operator's explicit variant choice for no benefit)
